baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicate rooted in س ج د at word 5 governs a subject series extending from heavens and earth through fixed bodies, plants, animals, and many humans.
baseline_models.mechanism: A downward relation links extremes of height, solidity, rooted growth, locomotion, and society. The relation to one divine agent makes the commonality yieldedness, not an identical bodily shape.

activation_trace.role: Supplies lowering and subjection, and functions as the shared relation across the heterogeneous subject list.
Supplies elevation, and functions as one end of the vertical span made to yield.
Supplies the lower domain opposed to the sky, and completes the vertical span.
Supplies elevated solidity, and makes apparently immovable mass part of the yielding relation.
Supplies ground-level creaturely motion, and extends the relation from fixed bodies to mobile life.

changed_reading.before: Various beings are reported to perform prostration.
changed_reading.after: One relational law crosses incompatible modes of being: high and low, fixed and moving, nonhuman and human all enact yieldedness appropriate to their domain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of ك ث ر at words 19 and 22 divide humanity after the otherwise convergent cosmic list, followed by fixed punishment, humiliation, and the negation of any restorer of honor.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated quantity word forms a hinge: one large human set joins the yielded cosmos, while another large set bears a settled liability. The final honor vocabulary translates that split into status that no creature can reverse.

activation_trace.role: Supplies numerical abundance twice, and functions as the balanced hinge between two large human sets.
Supplies fixed obligation or liability, and makes the second set's outcome settled rather than incidental.
Supplies punitive pain, and gives the settled liability its adverse consequence.
Supplies degradation by being made slight, and converts punishment into a status relation.
Supplies honor and generosity, and functions as the explicitly unavailable reversal of degradation.

changed_reading.before: A cosmic consensus is followed by an appended warning about some people.
changed_reading.after: The cosmic consensus exposes a specifically human bifurcation: two abundant human sets occupy opposite relations to the same order, one yielded and one fixed in dishonor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening perception question asks one addressee to apprehend a common act across subjects whose modes of prostration cannot all be directly watched in the same way.
baseline_models.mechanism: Seeing expands from eyesight into reflective recognition. The closing action-and-will clause compresses the diverse panorama into one causal source, so the observer is asked to infer dependency rather than merely report a spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Supplies sensory or insightful perception, and opens the panorama as evidence to be apprehended.
Supplies reflective judgment, and permits recognition of a common relation beyond direct eyesight.
Supplies the production of an act or effect, and functions as the causal close of the observed field.
Supplies will directed toward what comes to be, and gathers the many observed effects under one agency.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is asked whether a spectacle was seen.
changed_reading.after: The addressee is asked to recognize a hidden common dependency across the spectacle and reason from it to divine agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first renders overwhelming reality through destabilized earth and involuntary bodily failures. This gives the bodily branch of prostration a material analogue: creaturely autonomy is displaced before the event, though ordered prostration remains distinct from disorientation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies bending and lowering of the head, and anchors the contextual bodily analogy in the focus predicate.
Supplies violent disturbance, and removes the stable ground presumed by an upright body.
Supplies involuntary dropping of a carried burden, and embodies loss of ordinary bodily retention.
Supplies loss of sobriety and control, and marks the limit case of bodily de-centering.

structural_cues: 22:1-2 moves from earth-wide disturbance to failures of nursing, carrying, and sober human posture.
Punishment and perception are paired in 22:2 before both return in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shaking, dropped burden, and lost sobriety; I map their downward and disorganizing force onto the bodily branch of prostration. Deliberate worship remains a live alternative and should not be collapsed into catastrophe.

changed_reading.before: Prostration is primarily a stable ritual posture.
changed_reading.after: Prostration also registers creaturely loss of self-sufficiency under a reality that can displace ground, burden, and bodily control.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dead earth receives water, moves, swells through nourishment, and sends out growth. Because the focus explicitly names earth and tree, their prostration can be read as responsive transformation under an enabling act, not only as a static bow.

activation_trace.role: Supplies fertile, growth-bearing earth, and anchors the regenerative mechanism in a named focus subject.
Supplies stemmed vegetation, and carries the earth's response into visible growth.
Supplies earth and plant movement with renewed life, and makes response dynamic rather than merely positional.
Supplies nourishment and growth, and links received water to the earth's swelling response.
Supplies vegetation emerging from earth, and completes the response as produced life.
Supplies effect-producing action, and ties the regenerative sequence back to the focus close.

structural_cues: 22:5 places dead earth, descending water, movement, swelling, and growth in one causal sequence.
22:63 repeats the perception question and the water-to-green-earth sequence later in the surah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit enlivening sequence; I treat responsive growth as one nonhuman mode of yieldedness and connect it to the focus predicate. A purely posture-based metaphor remains possible but explains less of the repeated earth sequence.

changed_reading.before: Earth and tree are inert members of a cosmic bowing list.
changed_reading.after: Earth and tree prostrate through receptive transformation: what descends is received, movement begins, and life appears as an enacted response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah contrasts turning over on one's face, a disintegrative fall from the sky, and a governed cosmos in which earth is subjected while the sky is held from falling. Prostration is therefore calibrated lowering within a relation, not downward motion as such.

activation_trace.role: Supplies directed lowering and subjection, and anchors the distinction between ordered yielding and collapse.
Supplies reversal onto another face, and models unstable orientation under trial.
Supplies a noisy, disordered fall, and marks downward movement without relational integration.
Supplies descent into an abyss, and extends disordered falling toward loss of place.
Supplies directed subjection for a purpose, and names the governed relation underlying terrestrial motion.
Supplies holding and restraint, and shows that obedience can appear as maintained non-fall.
Supplies falling and coming to rest, and defines the motion that divine restraint prevents.

structural_cues: 22:11 places reversal on the face at the failure of edge-bound worship.
22:31 depicts association as fall, seizure, and remote descent.
22:65 repeats the perception question while pairing terrestrial subjection with the sky's restrained non-fall.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several vertical outcomes; I infer that direction toward the named recipient distinguishes prostration from inversion or collapse. The live alternative is that these are independent images with no shared vertical mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Any lowering or falling can image prostration.
changed_reading.after: Prostration is a preserved orientation under divine governance: it may involve lowering, motion, or restraint, but differs sharply from reversal, scattering, and abyssal fall.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus stands between a list of human confessional groups that God will separate and two adversarial parties immediately afterward. Its two abundant human sets become a hinge between cosmic convergence and human dispute awaiting adjudication.

activation_trace.role: Supplies two abundant sets, and provides the focus's internal partition of humanity.
Supplies settled liability, and gives adjudicative force to the second set's outcome.
Supplies judgment separating right from wrong, and frames the focus from before as an adjudicative partition.
Supplies contest between opposing parties, and frames the focus from after as the point where human convergence breaks.

structural_cues: 22:17 names multiple human groups and promises separation between them.
22:18 inserts universal cosmic prostration and the many-many human split.
22:19 opens with two adversarial parties in dispute over their Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the group list, separation, the focus split, and immediate opponents; I read the placement as a hinge from classification to adjudication. The alternative is simple topical succession without a deliberate hinge.

changed_reading.before: The two many-groups are a local contrast inside one verse.
changed_reading.after: They are the human fault line inside a larger adjudicative sequence: cosmic order converges, while human plurality is separated through dispute and judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sacrificial sequence makes animals marked rites and subjected bodies, then denies that their material reaches God while locating efficacy in protective inward orientation. This revises creaturely prostration from material performance alone into an embodied sign of directed relation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies moving creatures on earth, and anchors the ritual animal sequence in the focus list.
Supplies bodily subjection, and provides the relation that the ritual sequence makes sign-bearing.
Supplies a perceptible marker and ritual sign, and turns bodily material into an index of orientation.
Supplies purposeful subjection, and links the ritual animals to the focus's yielded creaturely field.
Supplies reaching or attaining, and distinguishes material non-arrival from relational efficacy.
Supplies placing the self within protection, and functions as the inward orientation that does reach.

structural_cues: 22:32-36 moves from honoring ritual signs to subjected animals arranged for sacrifice.
22:37 explicitly contrasts flesh and blood with the inward disposition that reaches God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sign, subjected animal, non-arriving material, and inward arrival; I infer that the focus's creaturely prostration is signifying relation rather than divine need for matter. A literal rite remains present and is not dissolved into symbolism.

changed_reading.before: Animals in the focus are passive members of a bodily prostration inventory.
changed_reading.after: Creaturely bodies can be enacted signs: their subjection reveals the worshipper's orientation, while material transfer itself is denied divine relevance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context gives concrete operations to the focus's honor polarity. Divine defense prevents demolition of worship spaces, honorable provision marks one outcome, and humiliating punishment marks the other; honor is sustained capacity and provision, not mere prestige.

activation_trace.role: Supplies degradation by being made slight, and anchors the adverse side of the focus polarity.
Supplies honor and generosity, and anchors the negated restorative side of the focus polarity.
Supplies removal of destructive pressure, and operationalizes support as preservation.
Supplies the pulling down of buildings, and defines what divine defense prevents.
Supplies a place of prostration, and makes preserved worship-space one concrete form of upheld honor.
Supplies apportioned provision, and gives the favorable status a sustaining material form.
Supplies honorable generosity, and names the quality of the favorable provision.
Supplies punitive pain, and repeats the adverse outcome from the focus.
Supplies humiliating degradation, and directly fuses punishment with the focus's status vocabulary.

structural_cues: 22:38-40 moves from divine defense to the preservation of multiple kinds of worship building.
22:50 pairs provision with honor, while 22:57 pairs punishment with humiliation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies defense, threatened demolition, worship-space, honorable provision, and humiliating punishment; I infer these are concrete realizations of the focus polarity. The alternative is that the later pairs are independent descriptions rather than an unpacking of 22:18.

changed_reading.before: Humiliation and honor name an abstract rank appended to the prostration scene.
changed_reading.after: They name operative conditions: being upheld, provisioned, and able to sustain worship versus being exposed to destructive and degrading consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ruined settlements are to be encountered by travel, but their meaning depends on reasoning hearts; the passage explicitly relocates blindness from eyes to hearts. The focus's opening perception is therefore historical and inferential sight through material traces.

activation_trace.role: Supplies reflective judgment, and anchors seeing as cognitive recognition in the focus.
Supplies movement through the land, and makes material encounter the input to recognition.
Supplies the faculty that restrains ignorance, and turns encountered traces into understanding.
Supplies blindness of heart and insight, and identifies the actual failure opposed to the focus question.
Supplies ordinary eyesight, and functions as the insufficient faculty explicitly contrasted with heart-recognition.

structural_cues: 22:45 presents ruins, an abandoned well, and a raised palace as material traces.
22:46 directs travel through earth and explicitly contrasts seeing eyes with blind hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet itself supplies the eye-heart contrast; I connect it backward to the focus's perception question and treat the cosmic list as evidence requiring judgment. The alternative is that 22:46 concerns only historical ruins, not the focus panorama.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks for visual recognition of cosmic prostration.
changed_reading.after: It asks for heart-sight: material forms are encountered, but their common yieldedness must be reasoned from traces rather than simply watched.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fly parable uses a tiny mobile creature to test rival agency: collective false objects cannot create it or recover what it takes, while the focus closes with divine action under will. The animal field is thus active evidence at the smallest scale, not inert decoration.

activation_trace.role: Supplies creatures moving on earth, and anchors the later fly within the focus's animal scale.
Supplies effect-producing action, and provides the divine-agency side of the scale test.
Supplies will directed to bringing about effects, and contrasts with the rivals' incapacity.
Supplies the presentation of a clarifying likeness, and frames the tiny creature as an agency test.
Supplies origination of a creature, and names the capacity denied to rival objects.
Supplies the fly itself, and makes minimal creaturely scale the decisive test.
Supplies aggregation of scattered powers, and shows that collective quantity does not cure incapacity.
Supplies extraction from another's grasp, and marks the failed attempt to reverse the fly's act.
Supplies lack of strength, and states the shared incapacity of seeker and sought.
Supplies true measure, and identifies the failed scale judgment exposed by the fly.

structural_cues: 22:73 contrasts total collective effort with inability to make or recover at fly scale.
22:74 immediately diagnoses this failure as not measuring God with true measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the tiny creature, rival incapacity, collective failure, and the focus's unrestricted divine action; I infer that animal agency is evidentiary within cosmic prostration. The alternative is that the parable critiques idols without revising the earlier animal list.

changed_reading.before: Animals merely join the panorama that submits.
changed_reading.after: Even a tiny creature acts within bestowed capacity and thereby exposes the inability of rival objects, making creaturely life an active witness to the focus's agency claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's final direct commands repeat the focus's prostration and action roots, coupling bodily lowering with doing good. The person initially asked to recognize cosmic prostration is finally recruited into it as an ethical agent.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an attention-directing question, and establishes the addressee first as observer.
Supplies the cosmic relation of lowering and subjection, and defines what the addressee is later commanded to enact.
Supplies bodily bending, and begins the explicit recruitment into lowered worship.
Supplies commanded prostration, and turns the focus's descriptive predicate into addressed practice.
Supplies deliberate action, and echoes the focus close at the level of human responsibility.
Supplies beneficial good, and specifies the ethical direction of human action.

structural_cues: 22:77 repeats bowing, prostrating, worship, and action as direct plural commands.
22:78 continues by making the addressed community witnesses over people and commanding them to hold fast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opening attention question and a closing command sequence sharing the focus roots; I infer a progression from recognition to participation. The alternative is that the ending is a general exhortation without a deliberate return to 22:18.

changed_reading.before: The addressee stands outside the cosmic scene and observes who prostrates.
changed_reading.after: Observation is preparatory recruitment: the addressee must enter the scene through bodily worship and beneficial action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant و س م mapping for the focus's sky root. It remains valid as a secondary activation because the same focus opens with perception and later context names ritual signs and repeats the perception question. Downstream prose should label it packet-enabled wordplay, not replace the ordinary sky meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus occurrence of س م و at word 9 is packet-mapped to a branch in which a visible sign lets an observer infer condition.

activation_trace.role: Supplies inference from a visible sign, and recasts the heavens as a legible part of the panorama.
Supplies perception, and anchors the sign-reading in the focus's opening demand.
Supplies a perceptible ritual marker, and confirms that material forms can function as signs.
Supplies repeated perception of sky-to-earth effect, and gives the sign-reading a later concrete recurrence.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are simply the highest region in the prostrating inventory.
changed_reading.after: Secondarily, the heavens can be carried as a marked surface whose effects let the observer read the condition of yielded creation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus surface plainly denotes vegetation while the retained branch denotes entangled dispute. It remains anchored in the supplied ش ج ر inventory and is activated by argument before the focus and adversaries immediately after it. Downstream prose should present it only as polysemous resonance, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus tree root at word 17 carries a branch of interlaced conflict while remaining governed by the prostration predicate.

activation_trace.role: Supplies interlaced dispute, and makes conflict itself a secondary image brought under the focus's lowering relation.
Supplies subjection, and anchors the conflict resonance in the actual governing predicate.
Supplies twisted, enveloping contention, and activates the tree root's entanglement branch before the focus.
Supplies opposing disputants, and gives the secondary conflict image immediate contextual continuation.

changed_reading.before: Trees are one literal vegetal member of the prostrating cosmos.
changed_reading.after: As secondary wordplay, the tree root also images branching, entangled contention being lowered before the surah turns to explicit adversaries.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links two different syntactic uses of ح ق ق across the surah. It remains valid because the packet supplies the same obligation branch for both the focus liability and the final demand for fully due striving. Downstream prose should call this a lexical reversal, not assert a direct grammatical equivalence or a complete causal theory of punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: At word 23 the focus makes punishment a settled liability; the final verse reuses the same root while commanding exertion to its due measure.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a binding liability, and fixes the adverse consequence upon the second human set.
Supplies punishment, and specifies what becomes due in the focus.
Supplies expenditure of full capacity under hardship, and gives the final due claim an active human form.
Supplies binding due-ness again, and reverses the focus vocabulary from received liability toward fulfilled obligation.

changed_reading.before: Due-ness in the focus only marks a sentence passively fixed upon people.
changed_reading.after: The final recurrence opens a secondary reversal: human life can meet a due claim through exertion, set against the due consequence borne by the refusing set.

strongest_changes: Repeated vertical reversals recast prostration as calibrated yieldedness, distinct from collapse.
Earth's enlivening turns nonhuman prostration into responsive process rather than static posture.
The focus becomes a hinge between classified human groups and disputants awaiting adjudication.
Ritual animals and the fly parable make creaturely bodies diagnostic signs of orientation and agency.
The final command sequence converts the opening observer into an ethical participant.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly reuses seeing, sky and earth, lowering and falling, animal subjection, honor and humiliation, and prostration itself. Those recurrences produced several compatible mechanisms without forcing one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not decide whether every nonhuman subject performs bodily prostration, functional obedience, or both.
The causal link between human non-prostration and fixed punishment remains implied rather than syntactically stated in 22:18.
Split-root and polysemous outliers are packet-licensed but should remain explicitly secondary.
